A Black Rat or Roof Rat (Rattus rattus), photographed in the Hagenbeck zoo in Hamburg, Germany.
Im Komposthaufen entdeckter Rattengang bzw. Löcher mit ca. Ø 10+ cm!
Rattus rattus can be told by his tail, which is longer than head and back combined. Rattus norvegicus, of plague fame, has a shorter tail in proportion to body and head.
